chat.author: Thomas Graf
chat.text: Regarding James Cummings comment on “validate” and "anchor" anydata substatement, https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/netmod/kIHYCAAH0GoJWKaPh-gKnv6Vd5g/ I believe this should be addressed in https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-netmod-yang-next-agreement-00#issue-29. That would ensure that anydata is no longer ambiguous due to "represent an unknown set of nodes that can be modeled with YANG" since the substatements could declare if the unknown set of nodes that are or are not modelled in YANG.
